title: Web Designer
description:
We are looking for a creative and detail-oriented **Web Designer** with **2–4** years of experience in website design and development. Candidates with additional experience in graphic design, including corporate branding, brochures, company profiles, social media creatives, and marketing materials, will be preferred.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Web Design & Development:** Design, develop, and maintain visually appealing, user-friendly, and responsive websites across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.
* **Graphic Design:** Create marketing materials, logos, icons, banners, brochures, company profiles, and other digital and print assets in line with company branding.
* **UI/UX & Prototyping:** Develop user-friendly interfaces, wireframes, mockups, and prototypes to enhance website usability and user experience.
* **Technical Implementation:** Update website content using CMS platforms such as WordPress or Webflow and implement basic HTML/CSS/JavaScript where required.
* **Collaboration:** Work with Sales, Pre-Sales, Project, and other relevant teams to align website designs and visual content with company branding and marketing requirements.
* **Optimization:** Ensure websites are visually appealing, fast-loading, user-friendly, and optimized for different browsers, devices, and basic SEO requirements.

**Requirements:**

* Bachelor's degree or Diploma in Web Design, Graphic Design, Computer Science, or a related field.
* **2–4** years of relevant experience in web design and website development.
* Proficiency in Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, and design tools such as Figma; knowledge of Adobe InDesign is an advantage.
* Good knowledge of HTML5 and CSS3; familiarity with JavaScript is an advantage.
* Experience with WordPress or other CMS platforms is preferred.
* Strong understanding of responsive design, UI/UX principles, typography, color theory, and website usability.
* Basic knowledge of SEO and website performance optimization.
* A portfolio showcasing website design projects; graphic design work is an added advantage.
* Good communication skills, creativity, attention to detail, and the ability to work collaboratively with different teams.

Pay: Up to ₹20,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Interior Designer
description:
Interior Designer

Company: Lavie Interiors by Zeba Labs

Location: Kakkanad, Kerala

Experience: 3–5 Years

Salary: ₹30,000\+ per month

Job Description

Lavie Interiors by Zeba Labs is looking for a passionate and creative Interior Designer to join our growing team. The ideal candidate should have strong design skills, good client\-handling abilities, and practical knowledge of interior execution and production drawings.

Key Responsibilities

\* Visit project sites and take accurate measurements.

\* Prepare detailed 2D and 3D drawings.

\* Prepare production/working drawings for execution.

\* Schedule and coordinate client meetings.

\* Understand client requirements and translate them into creative designs.

\* Present materials, finishes and design options to clients effectively.

\* Be involved in site visits, client discussions and design closure.

\* Work with the team to deliver projects on time and with quality.

What We’re Looking For

\* 3–5 years of experience in interior design.

\* Proficiency in AutoCAD, SketchUp, Lumion, Photoshop, Coohom and AI tools (e.g., Google Flow).

\* Strong knowledge of 2D, 3D and production/working drawings.

\* Ability to create accurate and detailed drawings.

\* Good communication and client\-handling skills.

\* Strong understanding of client requirements and various interior design styles.

\* Ability to suggest suitable materials, finishes and practical solutions.

\* Creative mindset with attention to detail and a passion for design.

Job Type: Full\-time

Salary: ₹30,000\+ per month

Experience: 3–5 years

Location: Kakkanad, Kerala

title: Senior Graphic Designer
description:
We are looking for a creative and detail\-oriented Graphic Designer to join our team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for creating visually appealing designs that communicate our brand message across digital and print platforms.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Design graphics for social media, websites, advertisements, and marketing materials
* Collaborate with marketing and content teams to develop creative concepts
* Create logos, brochures, banners, and other visual content
* Ensure brand consistency across all designs
* Edit and revise designs based on feedback
* Stay updated with design trends and tools

**Requirements:**

* Proven experience as a Graphic Designer or similar role
* Proficiency in tools like Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, and Adobe InDesign
* Strong portfolio showcasing design skills
* Good understanding of typography, color theory, and layout design
* Creativity and attention to detail
* Ability to meet deadlines and work independently

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in graphic design or a related field
* Experience with UI/UX design tools like Figma or Adobe XD
* Basic knowledge of video editing or animation
* 1\+ year experience in Graphic Designing

**Benefits:**

* Competitive salary
* Flexible working hours
* Opportunity to work on diverse projects
* Professional development opportunities

Pay: ₹20,000\.00 \- ₹30,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person
